summary: Iteration 4 backend-only regression testing after CORS relaxation (allow_credentials=False, allow_origins=*) and set_auth_cookie made a no-op. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_cors_bearer.py covering: CORS preflight from GitHub Pages origin, GET with Origin header, login returns token with no Set-Cookie for access_token, /auth/me works via Bearer header, invalid/missing token rejected 401, admin login (cassimiro77@gmail.com/admin123) role=admin, all admin+authenticated endpoints (admin/stats, admin/users, admin/bookings, bookings/mine, notifications/mine) reachable via Bearer only, public endpoints (professionals list, distance sorting with client_lat/lng, category filter, subscription/plans, root), and register→me→role gating on new cliente. 19/19 tests passed. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1020 lines; consider modularization (auth/, professionals/, bookings/, payments/, admin/) for maintainability.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=False is correct for Bearer-only auth (fixes GitHub Pages CORS). This is the right call now that cookies are gone.
logout endpoint still calls response.delete_cookie('access_token') — harmless but dead code since no cookie is ever set.
get_current_user still reads cookies.get('access_token') first — dead branch now; harmless but could be removed for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Register test creates+deletes one TEST_ prefixed cliente user (cleanup runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 4 covered CORS + Bearer-only auth regression after removing httpOnly cookie flow. All 19 tests pass on public URL. Prior iterations (1-3): 67/67 pass.
